title: DECoD
summary: A Python data-generation pipeline that loads tabular datasets, fits a CTGAN-based synthesizer, and evaluates the resulting synthetic data. It is built directly on the SDV library, using sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and sdv.evaluation.single_table functions (evaluate_quality, run_diagnostic) to generate, save, and assess synthetic tabular data.
